newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson topples Swedish shares, more losses seen.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson topples Swedish shares, more losses seen.

text.p: Swedish shares fell clearly in steady Thursday trade and brokers saw more losses ahead as recent buyers stayed away and some traders opened short positions; Ericsson slid nearly three percent.
The general index sank 1.19 percent to 3,106.48 in turnover totalling 3.6 billion crowns, average for the summer season.

"Investors who have been trading prices higher in the past week were not around today and it was trader-driven activity. Several people shorted index heavyweights and pressured prices," a broker said. The telecoms group Ericsson slid nine crowns to 317.5, and Finnish rival Nokia also fell.
Drug company Astra traded 3.5 crowns lower at 105.5 on profit-taking, brokers said.

Forestry companies lost some of the gains made a day earlier. The sector index dipped 0.32 percent after jumping 3.25 percent on Wednesday after U.S. counterparts gained on news International Paper Co. planned to sell $1 billion worth of assets and slash 9,000 jobs.
Some players argued Swedish companies could follow suit.
